LESSON: MELODY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.5: Melody
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Melody, part of Creating and Executing in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to apply composition techniques in composing a melody? 2. Why is calligraphy lettering used in writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

A. At school

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Melody together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: The learner develops self-efficacy when creating their own melodies and recording using digital devices.

● Digital literacy: developed as the learner connects to digital devices to search and watch videos of hand signs and practice

performing them, recording and presenting their own created melodies.

● Creativity and imagination: The learner explores the solfa syllables and note values to create original melodies and cards.
